newProfile.title.description: Heading at the top of the Roku Create Profile screen, shown when adding a new profile.

newProfile.subtitle.description: Short instruction under the heading on the Roku new-profile screen, asking the user to type a name for the profile.

newProfile.preview.description: Small caption above the sample profile tile on the Roku new-profile screen; the tile updates live as the user types a name.

newProfile.previewName.description: Placeholder name shown on the sample profile tile on the Roku new-profile screen until the user types a real name.

newProfile.name.description: Row label for the profile name field on the Roku new-profile screen; also the title of the on-screen keyboard when editing the name.

newProfile.namePlaceholder.description: Hint text inside the empty profile name field on the Roku new-profile screen and its on-screen keyboard.

newProfile.pin.description: Row label for the optional PIN field on the Roku new-profile screen; also the title of the on-screen keyboard when entering the PIN.

newProfile.pinPlaceholder.description: Hint text inside the empty PIN field on the Roku new-profile screen and its keyboard, asking for a four-digit number.

newProfile.pinHint.description: Helper line under the PIN field on the Roku new-profile screen explaining that a PIN must be four digits or left empty.

newProfile.child.description: Toggle row label on the Roku new-profile screen that marks the profile as a child profile.

newProfile.childDetail.description: Secondary description line under the Child Profile toggle on the Roku new-profile screen.

newProfile.rating.description: Row label on the Roku new-profile screen, and title of its picker, for choosing the highest content rating a child profile may watch.

newProfile.rating.g.description: Option in the maximum content rating picker on the Roku new-profile screen: the lowest, all-ages level, listing movie and TV rating codes.

newProfile.rating.pg.description: Option in the maximum content rating picker on the Roku new-profile screen: parental-guidance level, listing the matching movie and TV rating codes.

newProfile.rating.pg13.description: Option in the maximum content rating picker on the Roku new-profile screen: teen level, listing the matching movie and TV rating codes.

newProfile.rating.r.description: Option in the maximum content rating picker on the Roku new-profile screen: the most mature level, listing the matching movie and TV rating codes.

newProfile.restrict.description: Toggle row label on the Roku new-profile screen that limits a child profile to a chosen set of libraries.

newProfile.allowed.description: Label above the list of library checkboxes on the Roku new-profile screen, for the libraries this profile may access.

newProfile.librariesLoading.description: Status note on the Roku new-profile screen shown while the library list is being fetched from the server.

newProfile.librariesFailed.description: Status note on the Roku new-profile screen shown when the library list could not be fetched from the server.

newProfile.librariesEmpty.description: Status note on the Roku new-profile screen shown when the server has no libraries that can be assigned to the profile.

newProfile.create.description: Button on the Roku new-profile screen that submits the form and creates the profile.

newProfile.creating.description: Label the Create Profile button on the Roku new-profile screen shows while the request is in progress.

newProfile.on.description: Value shown at the end of a toggle row on the Roku new-profile screen when the option is enabled.

newProfile.off.description: Value shown at the end of a toggle row on the Roku new-profile screen when the option is disabled.

newProfile.ok.description: Dismiss button on the error and validation dialogs of the Roku new-profile screen.

newProfile.error.title.description: Title of the Roku dialog shown when creating a profile fails or the primary profile PIN must be re-entered.

newProfile.error.failed.description: Body of the Roku dialog shown when creating a profile fails for an unknown reason; the user can retry.

newProfile.error.name.description: Body of the Roku validation dialog shown when the user tries to create a profile with an empty name.

newProfile.error.nameTitle.description: Title of the Roku validation dialog shown when the profile name is empty.

newProfile.error.pin.description: Body of the Roku validation dialog shown when the PIN has fewer than four digits; the user must complete it or clear it.

newProfile.error.pinTitle.description: Title of the Roku validation dialog shown when the entered PIN is incomplete.

newProfile.error.library.description: Body of the Roku validation dialog shown when a child profile is restricted to libraries but none is selected.

newProfile.error.libraryTitle.description: Title of the Roku validation dialog shown when a library-restricted child profile has no library chosen.

newProfile.error.verify.description: Body of the Roku dialog shown when the server needs the primary profile's PIN again before it will create the new profile.

newProfile.refused.title.description: Title of the Roku dialog shown when the server refuses to create the profile; the server's own reason appears as the body.

newProfile.unconfirmed.title.description: Title of the Roku dialog shown when the server never answered the create request, so it is unknown whether the profile exists.

newProfile.unconfirmed.body.description: Body of the Roku dialog shown when the create-profile request got no server reply; advises checking the profile list before retrying.

player.tryAnyway.description: Button on the Roku player error screen that retries playback even though the device may not support the stream.

player.goBack.description: Button on the Roku player error screen that leaves the player and returns to the previous screen.

player.skipRecap.description: Button shown over video on Roku during a recap segment; selecting it jumps past the recap.

player.skipCredits.description: Button shown over video on Roku during the end credits; selecting it jumps past the credits.

player.holdHint.description: Key hint line on Roku shown while the user holds a seek button: left/right arrows change speed, OK plays, Back cancels. Keep the arrows and button names aligned with the remote.

player.hud.title.description: Row label in the Roku playback info panel for the title of what is playing.

player.hud.stream.description: Section heading in the Roku playback info panel for details about the stream being delivered.

player.hud.playback.description: Section heading in the Roku playback info panel for playback state, such as direct play or transcode.

player.hud.sync.description: Section heading in the Roku playback info panel for audio and video sync details.

player.hud.tracks.description: Section heading in the Roku playback info panel for the selected audio and subtitle tracks.

player.hud.options.description: Section heading in the Roku playback info panel for the current playback options.

player.hud.channels.description: Row label in the Roku playback info panel for the number of audio channels.

player.hud.codec.description: Row label in the Roku playback info panel for the audio or video codec in use.

player.hud.route.description: Row label in the Roku playback info panel for how the stream is delivered to the device.

player.hud.audio.description: Row label in the Roku playback info panel for the current audio track.

player.hud.subtitles.description: Row label in the Roku playback info panel for the current subtitle track.

player.hud.file.description: Row label in the Roku playback info panel for the source media file name.

player.hud.switching.description: Value in the Roku playback info panel shown while the player is changing to another track or quality.

player.hud.external.description: Value in the Roku playback info panel marking a subtitle track that comes from a separate file rather than inside the video.

player.hud.none.description: Placeholder dash in the Roku playback info panel when a value is not available.

player.audio.scrubber.description: Spoken (accessibility) description of the progress bar on the Roku audio player. {elapsed}: current position, such as 1:23; {runtime}: total length, such as 4:05.

player.audio.skipBack.description: Spoken label for the skip-back button on the Roku audio player. Plural counts the seconds skipped; {seconds}: the number of seconds.

player.audio.play.description: Label for the play button on the Roku audio player, shown while paused.

player.audio.pause.description: Label for the pause button on the Roku audio player, shown while playing.

player.audio.skipForward.description: Spoken label for the skip-forward button on the Roku audio player. Plural counts the seconds skipped; {seconds}: the number of seconds.

player.audio.upNext.description: Label for the button on the Roku audio player that opens the queue of upcoming tracks.

player.audio.options.description: Spoken label for the button on the Roku audio player that opens track info and options.

player.audio.close.description: Spoken label for the button that closes the Roku audio player.

player.previewsUnavailable.description: Message in the Roku seek preview area when no thumbnail previews exist for the video being scrubbed.

player.trackRefused.description: Brief on-screen notice on Roku when the player rejects a switch to the audio track the user picked.

player.subtitleRefused.description: Brief on-screen notice on Roku when the player cannot display the subtitle the user picked.

player.qualityRefused.description: Brief on-screen notice on Roku when the player rejects the video quality the user picked.

player.subtitleUnshown.description: Brief on-screen notice on Roku shown when subtitles are selected but the device cannot render them.

catalog.runtimeHoursMinutes.description: Runtime on Roku for a movie or episode lasting hours and minutes, using short unit letters. {hours}: whole hours; {minutes}: remaining minutes.

catalog.runtimeHours.description: Runtime on Roku for a title lasting an exact number of hours, using a short unit letter. {hours}: the number of hours.

catalog.runtimeMinutes.description: Runtime on Roku for a title shorter than an hour, with an abbreviated unit. {minutes}: the number of minutes.

catalog.extra.trailer.description: Label on Roku for a bonus video of type trailer, in the Trailers & More rail on a title page.

catalog.extra.teaser.description: Label on Roku for a bonus video of type teaser, a short early promo, in the Trailers & More rail.

catalog.extra.featurette.description: Label on Roku for a bonus video of type featurette, a short documentary about the making of a title.

catalog.extra.clip.description: Label on Roku for a bonus video of type clip, a short excerpt from a title.

catalog.extra.behind_the_scenes.description: Label on Roku for a bonus video showing behind-the-scenes footage of a title.

catalog.extra.bloopers.description: Label on Roku for a bonus video of bloopers or outtakes.

catalog.extra.deleted_scene.description: Label on Roku for a bonus video of a scene cut from the final title.

catalog.extra.otherExtra.description: Fallback label on Roku for a bonus video whose type is not otherwise recognized, such as a generic extra.

catalog.episodeTag.description: Compact episode tag on Roku cards, such as S2E5. {season}: the season number; {episode}: the episode number.

catalog.episodeCaption.description: Episode caption on Roku cards, such as S2 · E5, with a middle dot separator. {season}: the season number; {episode}: the episode number.

catalog.seasons.description: Number of seasons a series has, shown on Roku cards and title pages. Plural counts seasons; {count}: the number of seasons.

catalog.ratingImdb.description: Community rating from IMDb shown on Roku. {value}: the score, such as 7.8. Keep the brand name IMDb.

catalog.ratingTmdb.description: Community rating from TMDB shown on Roku. {value}: the score, such as 7.8. Keep the brand name TMDB.

catalog.audioEpisode.description: Spoken (screen reader) description of an episode on Roku. {season}: the season number; {episode}: the episode number.

catalog.sort.title.description: Sort option on the Roku library screen: order items alphabetically by title.

catalog.sort.added.description: Sort option on the Roku library screen: order items by when they were added to the library.

catalog.sort.released.description: Sort option on the Roku library screen: order items by release date.

catalog.sort.year.description: Sort option on the Roku library screen: order items by release year.

catalog.sort.rating.description: Sort option on the Roku library screen: order items by community rating.

catalog.sort.runtime.description: Sort option on the Roku library screen: order items by running time.

catalog.sort.resolution.description: Sort option on the Roku library screen: order items by video resolution.

catalog.letters.all.description: First entry in the A-Z jump rail on the Roku library screen; selecting it shows items for all letters.

overlays.multiAudio.description: Short badge drawn on Roku poster cards for titles that offer more than one audio track.

overlays.subtitles.description: Very short badge drawn on Roku poster cards for titles that have subtitles; closed captions abbreviation.

overlays.runtimeHoursMinutes.description: Runtime badge drawn on Roku poster cards for titles of an hour or more, in short units. {hours}: whole hours; {minutes}: remaining minutes.

overlays.runtimeMinutes.description: Runtime badge drawn on Roku poster cards for titles under an hour, in a short unit. {minutes}: the number of minutes.

overlays.returning.description: Status badge on Roku poster cards for a series that is still airing or will return with new episodes.

overlays.ended.description: Status badge on Roku poster cards for a series that has finished airing.

overlays.cancelled.description: Status badge on Roku poster cards for a series that was cancelled.

overlays.upcoming.description: Status badge on Roku poster cards for a title that is announced but not yet released.

detail.play.description: Primary button on the Roku title page that starts playing the movie or episode from the beginning.

detail.resumeAt.description: Primary button on the Roku title page that continues playback from where the user stopped. {time}: the saved position, such as 42:10.

detail.playEpisode.description: Primary button on the Roku series page that plays a specific episode. {season}: the season number; {episode}: the episode number.

detail.resumeEpisode.description: Primary button on the Roku series page that continues a partly watched episode. {season}: the season number; {episode}: the episode number.

detail.startOver.description: Button on the Roku title page that restarts a partly watched title from the beginning.

detail.versionsButton.description: Button on the Roku title page that opens a picker of the available file versions (for example different resolutions).

detail.audioButton.description: Button on the Roku title page that opens a picker for the audio track to play.

detail.version.description: Title of the Roku picker for choosing which file version of a title to play.

detail.audio.description: Title of the Roku picker for choosing the audio track before playback.

detail.subtitles.description: Button on the Roku title page, and title of its picker, for choosing the subtitle track.

detail.watchlist.description: Button on the Roku title page that adds or removes the title from the user's watchlist.

detail.watchlistAdd.description: Spoken (accessibility) label for the watchlist button on Roku when pressing it will add the title.

detail.watchlistRemove.description: Spoken (accessibility) label for the watchlist button on Roku when pressing it will remove the title.

detail.more.description: Button on the Roku title page, and title of its menu, that opens extra actions such as favorites and marking watched.

detail.more.addFavorite.description: Menu action in the Roku More menu (title page or card menu) that adds the item to Favorites.

detail.more.removeFavorite.description: Menu action in the Roku More menu (title page or card menu) that removes the item from Favorites.

detail.more.markWatched.description: Menu action in the Roku More menu that marks a movie as watched.

detail.more.markUnwatched.description: Menu action in the Roku More menu that marks a movie as not watched.

detail.more.markSeriesWatched.description: Menu action in the Roku More menu that marks every episode of a series as watched.

detail.more.markSeriesUnwatched.description: Menu action in the Roku More menu that marks every episode of a series as not watched.

detail.more.markSeasonWatched.description: Menu action in the Roku More menu that marks every episode of a season as watched.

detail.more.markSeasonUnwatched.description: Menu action in the Roku More menu that marks every episode of a season as not watched.

detail.more.markEpisodeWatched.description: Menu action in the Roku More menu that marks a single episode as watched.

detail.more.markEpisodeUnwatched.description: Menu action in the Roku More menu that marks a single episode as not watched.

detail.more.shuffleSeason.description: Menu action in the Roku More menu that plays a season's episodes in random order. {season}: the season name, such as Season 2.

detail.more.shuffleSeries.description: Menu action in the Roku More menu that plays a series' episodes in random order.

detail.more.translate.description: Menu action in the Roku More menu that translates the title's description into the user's language using AI.

detail.translation.translating.description: Status text on the Roku title page shown while the description is being translated.

detail.translation.translated.description: Small status note on the Roku title page saying the shown description was machine-translated by AI.

detail.auto.description: Option in the Roku version, audio and subtitle pickers that lets Silo choose automatically.

detail.autoVersion.description: Description under the Auto option in the Roku version picker: Silo picks the file that suits this device.

detail.autoAudio.description: Description under the Auto option in the Roku audio picker: the audio language follows the user's Playback settings.

detail.autoSubtitles.description: Description under the Auto option in the Roku subtitle picker: subtitles follow the user's subtitle settings.

detail.off.description: Option in the Roku subtitle picker, and summary value, meaning no subtitles.

detail.offDetail.description: Description under the Off option in the Roku subtitle picker, meaning playback starts with subtitles disabled.

detail.none.description: Summary value on the Roku title page when no subtitle track is selected or available.

detail.unknown.description: Summary value on the Roku title page when the audio track or its language is not known.

detail.autoValue.description: Summary on the Roku title page for an automatic choice, showing what it resolved to. {value}: the chosen track or version, such as English.

detail.readout.version.description: Small all-caps label on the Roku title page above the currently selected file version.

detail.readout.audio.description: Small all-caps label on the Roku title page above the currently selected audio track.

detail.readout.subtitles.description: Small all-caps label on the Roku title page above the currently selected subtitle track.

detail.track.description: Fallback name for an audio or subtitle track with no language or title in the Roku pickers. {number}: the track's position, such as 2.

detail.trackDefault.description: Tag in the Roku track pickers marking the track flagged as default in the file.

detail.trackPreferred.description: Tag in the Roku track pickers marking the track that matches the user's language preference.

detail.trackForced.description: Tag in the Roku subtitle picker marking a forced subtitle track, which only translates foreign-language parts.

detail.trackSdh.description: Tag in the Roku subtitle picker for subtitles for the deaf and hard of hearing; keep the SDH abbreviation if it is used locally.

detail.trackExternal.description: Tag in the Roku track pickers marking a subtitle that comes from a separate file rather than inside the video.

detail.trackUnsupported.description: Tag in the Roku track pickers marking a track whose format the device cannot play or show.

detail.stereo.description: Audio channel layout shown in Roku track pickers: two channels, left and right.

detail.mono.description: Audio channel layout shown in Roku track pickers: a single channel.

detail.channels.description: Audio channel count in Roku track pickers, with a short unit. {count}: the number of channels, such as 6.

detail.sizeGb.description: File size in gigabytes in the Roku version picker. {size}: the number, such as 4.2.

detail.sizeMb.description: File size in megabytes in the Roku version picker. {size}: the number, such as 850.

detail.season.description: Name of a season on the Roku series page, such as in the season row. {number}: the season number.

detail.specials.description: Name of the season on the Roku series page that holds special episodes outside regular numbering.

detail.episode.description: Episode label on the Roku series page. {number}: the episode number.

detail.directedBy.description: Credit line on the Roku title page naming the director or directors. {names}: a list of names, such as Jane Doe, John Roe.

detail.starring.description: Credit line on the Roku title page naming the lead actors. {names}: a list of names, such as Jane Doe, John Roe.

detail.details.description: Heading of the Roku title page section that lists facts such as studio, country and release date.

detail.director.description: Row label in the Roku Details section for the director of a title.

detail.writer.description: Row label in the Roku Details section for the writer of a title.

detail.writtenBy.description: Short label on the Roku title page introducing the writer credit.

detail.studio.description: Row label in the Roku Details section for the production studio.

detail.network.description: Row label in the Roku Details section for the TV network that airs a series.

detail.country.description: Row label in the Roku Details section for the country of origin.

detail.genres.description: Row label in the Roku Details section for the title's genres.

detail.released.description: Row label in the Roku Details section for a movie's release date.

detail.firstAired.description: Row label in the Roku Details section for the date a series first aired.

detail.lastAired.description: Row label in the Roku Details section for the date a series last aired.

detail.aired.description: Row label in the Roku Details section for when an episode aired.

detail.error.load.description: Message on the Roku title page shown when loading the title failed; a retry button accompanies it. Mentions the TV's network connection.

detail.error.missing.description: Message on the Roku title page shown when the title no longer exists on the server.

detail.error.noSeries.description: Message on the Roku title page shown when an episode or season cannot be matched to its parent series.

detail.episodes.empty.description: Message in the episode list on the Roku series page when the season has no episodes.

detail.episodes.error.description: Message in the episode list on the Roku series page when loading the episodes failed; a retry is offered.

detail.cast.description: Heading of the cast and crew rail on the Roku title page.

detail.relatedMovies.description: Heading of the rail of similar movies on the Roku movie page.

detail.trailers.description: Heading of the rail of trailers and other bonus videos on the Roku title page.

detail.recommendedSeries.description: Heading of the rail of suggested similar series on the Roku series page.
